name: Avocado Caprese Salad with Grilled Chicken

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat the grill or skillet with oil. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the minced garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit the avocados; slice the flesh crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Wash the tomatoes and basil. Halve the tomatoes. Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves crosswise into ribbons.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkg grape tomatoes
1 ½ small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (227 g) ball fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the mixed greens.
Slice the chicken crosswise on a angle.
Arrange a bed of the mixed greens on a plate, top with the tomatoes, avocado slices, mozzarella, and chicken. Sprinkle with basil and drizzle with balsamic vinaigrette. Enjoy!
